description.zh: 数据是否进过base64编码，true - 已编码， false - 未编码。
description.en: Specifies whether the data has been encoded in Base64. Valid values: true and false.

description.zh: 阿里云证书服务的证书ID。
description.en: The certificate ID provided by Alibaba Cloud Certificate Management Service.
The region in which the certificate is stored.

description.zh:
保密配置数据，使用JSON数组表示，数组对象包括以下内容：
- Key：保密配置键
- Value：保密配置值
description.en:
The data of the Secret. The value must be a JSON array that contains the following information:

- Key: Secret key

- Value: Secret value

description.zh: 保密配置名称，必须以字母开头，支持数字、字母和短划线（-），最多支持63个字符。
description.en: The name of the Secret. The name must start with a letter, and can contain digits, letters, and hyphens (-). It can be up to 63 characters in length.
The namespace of the Kubernetes cluster.

description.zh:
保密配置类型，支持以下两种类型：

- Opaque：用户自定义数据类型

- kubernetes.io/tls：TLS证书类型
description.en:
The Secret type. Valid values:

- Opaque: user-defined data

- kubernetes.io/tls: Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas create-k8s-secret --cluster-id 712082c3-0000-0000-9217-a947b5cde6ee --name my-secret --namespace default --type Opaque --data Key_:_name_,_Value_:_william_,_Key_:_age_,_Value_:_12 --cert-id 6651483 --cert-region-id cn-hangzhou --base64-encoded true --region cn-hangzhou
